_source: Static UI keys for the mobile Notifications screen (route notif, pototype/mobile.jsx MobileNotifications L543-609). KEYS ONLY — every value is the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key (read with tp). FIVE already exist in docs/extract/i18n-full.json phrases: 'แจ้งเตือน','ของฉัน','ทั้งหมด','รออนุมัติ','ระบบ'. TWO are net-new and collected into agents/orch-b-recon/mobile-notif-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (markRead 'อ่าน', filterUpdate 'แจ้งอัปเดต'); they already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. Each value is byte-exact with the prototype. The per-notification title/by/body text the mock denormalises is server data the wire does not carry (contract gap B-039) — it is NOT an i18n key; the view renders the real ref / an em-dash, never an invented sentence (§0 rule 3).
_layers: all tp() = phrases (the Thai phrase is the key)
title: ของฉัน
filterUpdate: แจ้งอัปเดต
